headline: President Trump signed an executive order on March 13, 2026, aimed at making it easier for people to get mortgage loans.
what_it_does: The order's title says it is meant to promote access to mortgage credit, meaning home loans. No summary of the order's actual contents was provided, so its specific rules, directions to agencies, or deadlines are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at access to mortgage credit, so it may affect how easily home buyers and homeowners can get loans, but the details are not available.
Lenders may be affected if the order leads to changes in federal mortgage rules, but the specifics are not given.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 13, 2026; the effective date of specific provisions is not stated in the available information.
